C1594.title: Large-Scale Attacks on Medical IoT Devices Could Lead to Catastrophic Consequences
C1594.summary: Research indicates that large-scale attacks on medical devices may target device availability or integrity. If attackers successfully compromise the availability of medical devices, such as causing monitors or infusion pumps to stop functioning, it could result in catastrophic outcomes, directly threatening patient lives.

references.title: Medical Device Security in the IoT Age
